targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM public.claude_actions WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
SELECT round(100.0*avg(CASE WHEN outcome='success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),1) AS value FROM public.claude_actions WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM public.gateway_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM public.slack_watch_reports WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
SELECT $__timeGroup(ts,'1h') AS time, action_type AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM public.claude_actions WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, action_type ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroup(created_at,'1h') AS time, 'p95 total' AS metric, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_ms) AS value FROM public.gateway_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND total_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__timeGroup(created_at,'1h') AS time, 'avg ttft' AS metric, avg(ttft_ms) AS value FROM public.gateway_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND ttft_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT ts AS "Time", action_type AS "Type", left(target,40) AS "Target", outcome AS "Outcome", left(description,60) AS "Detail" FROM public.claude_actions WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 25
